entry.title: What Is Foidslop Media?
entry.summary: Foidslop media is female-coded media: romance, life sims, teen drama, anime, books, games, pop culture, and anything else with obvious foid density.

entry.title: The Anatomy of a Foidslop Username
entry.summary: Foidslop usernames are names like bunni, kitty, angel, fae, pixie, mochi, sushi, rottingangel, dollparts, and wiredprincess. There are rules.

entry.title: Why Is Everything Slop Now?
entry.summary: AI slop, franchise slop, foidslop, goyslop, guyslop, content slop. The internet discovered one suffix that works on almost everything.

entry.title: How Forum Slang Goes Mainstream
entry.summary: Foid, mog, looksmaxxing, slop, based, cope, aura. Forum and subculture slang keeps ending up in normal feeds because the path from 4chan to TikTok is short.

entry.title: Girl Dinner Was Only the Beginning
entry.summary: Girl dinner named the snack plate. Then came guyslop, wifechow, moidslop, foidslop, and an increasingly detailed fake science of who eats what.

entry.title: How Internet Labels Turn Into Genres
entry.summary: Girl dinner, foidslop, femcel music, Tumblr girl, BookTok romance. Give the internet a label and people will start sorting things into it immediately.
